read.thesis: Margin held at 10.9% and EPS guide raised to $5.20-5.35 on buybacks and tax, but sales guide narrowed and organic sales fell 4% to 2.5%, with the battery headwind and the data-centre pivot still pre-revenue.

triggers.label: Turbine generator $300M first-year revenue
triggers.quote: Then we expect to see $300 million of turbine generator revenue.

triggers.label: Adj EPS guide raised to $5.20-5.35
triggers.quote: we are increasing our expected full-year adjusted EPS in the range of $5.20 to $5.35 per diluted share

triggers.label: Battery sales decline $250M headwind
triggers.quote: we expect a sales decline in our battery business due to the lack of North American incentives and weaker European demand.

triggers.label: Electronics inflation rising into 2027
triggers.quote: we are seeing a bit higher inflation cost on the electronic side of our business.

guidance.quote: we are increasing our expected full-year adjusted EPS in the range of $5.20 to $5.35 per diluted share
We currently project total 2026 sales in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.2 billion
we expect our 2026 organic sales change to be down 4% to down 2.5% year-over-year
We continue to expect our full-year adjusted operating margin to be in the range of 10.7% to 10.9%
we continue to expect full-year free cash flow to be in the range of $900 million to $1.1 billion
we expect to see $300 million of turbine generator revenue

red_flags.label: Organic sales down, guidance trimmed
red_flags.quote: We are modestly adjusting the high end of our full-year sales outlook based on a narrowing of our industry production expectations.

red_flags.label: Electronics cost inflation
red_flags.quote: we are seeing a bit higher inflation cost on the electronic side of our business.

evasions.topic: Turbine generator revenue shape and contract status
evasions.quote: We will not be giving you any kind of color until we get into early 2027.
I do not know if we are ready to comment on that.
